#languages #hindi

Devanagari hangs from the shirorekha, the top line, and every consonant carries an inherent "a": क = ka, so कम is
"kam". Vowel signs (matras) attach around the consonant, and ि (short i) is written before the letter it follows in
speech, which broke my brain for a week: कि = ki. Conjuncts like क्ष (ksha) and त्र (tra) still look like puzzles.
Started 4 November 2024 with the Hindi Pod 101 alphabet videos and a ₹149 practice workbook Ritika mailed me from
Jaipur. Goal: read a full Bollywood poster by summer. Idioms I collected are in [[हिंदी मुहावरे]], and the
comparison with right-to-left scripts is in [[Arabic script basics]].
